commands.command:
set -eu
boot_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
service_state=$(systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service)
enablement=$(systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service)
worker_pid=$(systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p MainPID --value)
account_uid=$(id -u inventorysvc)
account_gid=$(id -g inventorysvc)
process_uid=$(sed -n 's/^Uid:[[:space:]]*\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p' "/proc/$worker_pid/status")
process_gid=$(sed -n 's/^Gid:[[:space:]]*\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p' "/proc/$worker_pid/status")
test "$boot_id" != 93dd959e-d32f-4398-8e14-61f8933af912
test "$service_state" = active
test "$enablement" = enabled
test "$worker_pid" -gt 0
test "$process_uid" = "$account_uid"
test "$process_gid" = "$account_gid"
printf 'post_restart_assertions=PASS\nboot_id=%s\nservice=%s\nenablement=%s\nmain_pid=%s\naccount_uid_gid=%s:%s\nprocess_uid_gid=%s:%s\n' "$boot_id" "$service_state" "$enablement" "$worker_pid" "$account_uid" "$account_gid" "$process_uid" "$process_gid"
printf 'cmdline='; tr '\000' ' ' < "/proc/$worker_pid/cmdline"; printf '\n'
systemctl show inventory-worker.service -p User -p Group -p ExecStart -p SubState -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --no-pager
journalctl -b -u inventory-worker.service --no-pager -n 5
